relationships.evidence: We evaluated the models on benchmarks corresponding to their respective training levels. In Section 3.2, we evaluate the model’s ability using five function-level code generation benchmarks. Specifically, HumanEval (Chen et al., 2021), MBPP (Austin et al., 2021), BigCodeBench (Zhuo et al., 2025), EvoEval (Xia et al., 2024) and FullStackBench (Liu et al., 2024). (Section 3.2)
